<script>
function wopen(img, w, h)
{
	var ww = w + 30;
	var hh = h + 60;
	window.open('diapo.php?img='+img,'popimg','scrollbars=no,width='+ww+',height='+hh+',statusbar=no,menubar=no,toolbar=no,resizable=yes,top=50,left=50');
}
</script>
